text: 国务院批复《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，加强消费基础设施建设。促进消费和投资良性互动，扩大消费基础设施领域有效投资。实施城市商业提质行动，深化现代商贸流通体系试点，推进老旧商业街区改造提升，支持线下消费商业设施设备更新。推进城市社区嵌入式服务设施、完整社区和一刻钟便民生活圈建设，完善社区便民商业设施。
text_en: The State Council approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption,' strengthening consumption infrastructure. Positive interaction between consumption and investment will be promoted, increasing effective investment in consumption infrastructure. Actions to improve urban commerce will be implemented, pilot projects to deepen modern commercial distribution systems will be advanced, renovation of old commercial streets will be upgraded, and updates to offline commercial facility equipment will be supported. The construction of urban community embedded service facilities, complete communities, and 15-minute convenience living circles will be promoted, improving community convenience commercial facilities.
